instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium full shot shows a lively scene at an outdoor park with a grassy lawn. On the left, the woman with a large afro (R6) in a red t-shirt and blue jeans dances happily with her arms slightly raised. On the right, the East Asian man (R3) in a red polo shirt and blue jeans dances alongside her, pointing forward with a joyful expression. They are both smiling and moving to the music on the green grass under the soft shade of background trees. The lighting is bright and natural.
